pages.title: About
pages.text: The closest planet to the Sun. The map asks for a tier 3 rocket. Gravity is about 39% of Earth's. With no air there is no pressure, but it is very hot. Bring $(l:space/survival/hazards#heat)tier 4 thermal protection$().

pages.title: Resources
pages.text: Iron, nickel and magnesium. Magnesium goes into the suit's Gravity module and other GalaxySpace parts. If you only need magnesium, $(l:space/planets/jupiter#ganymede)Ganymede$() has it too.

pages.title: Magnesium
pages.text: Its ore is on Mercury and Ganymede.
